Gloves

Personal protective equipment commonly known as PPEs have gained great importance and value throughout the world due to life-threatening pandemic, COVID-19 disease. Medical gloves constitute the most essential component of PPEs. Disposable medical gloves include examination gloves, surgical gloves, utility gloves and medical gloves for handling dental instruments, chemotherapeutic agents, dental materials and performing oral treatment procedures. Wearing aprons, gloves, safety glasses and using high volume suction is mandatory for the prevention of infection spread through aerosol generating dental treatment procedures in the dental office. Skydentalsupply provides good quality latex and nitrile medical gloves in optimal thickness and sizes ranging from extra-small to extra-large.

Skydentalsupply offers several types of gloves that can protect against different types of chemicals, saliva, dental cements, monomers, restorative materials and irritants which can come in contact with the hand skin during treatment procedures. These gloves include butyl rubber gloves, natural latex/rubber gloves, neoprene gloves, nitrile rubber gloves, and vinyl gloves. Adenna Gold Latex Gloves, Advance Diamond Latex Gloves, and Adenna Platinum Latex PF Gloves exhibit superior fit, high level of touch sensitivity, highly elasticity, great strength, bio-degradability and cost-effectiveness. These can be worn for an extended period of time, and work well for high risk situations involving infectious materials. These are lightly powdered to absorb sweat and moisture during the treatment procedures.

Some health care workers can develop allergic reactions to latex gloves. Skydentalsupply nitrile and vinyl gloves are the best solution to avoid these allergic reactions. Advance Diamond Nitrile Gloves, Aurelia Amazing Nitrile-Powder Free Examination Gloves, Aurelia Blush Nitrile Powder Free Exam Gloves Pink, and Aurelia Bold Black Nitrile Powder Free Examination Gloves resist chemicals, liquids and provide an ideal alternative when latex allergies are of concern. These also show superior puncture resistance to latex gloves. These gloves show high level of sensitivity, greater fit, have a longer shelf life, and are available in blue or black color to help identify if the gloves have been punctured. Adenna Vinyl Gloves, Life Guard Vinyl Gloves, and Sky Choice Vinyl Gloves have a looser fit, are good for short term, low risk tasks, are an economic option, best for use with non-hazardous materials, and are lightly powdered to make it easier to put on.

Skydentalsupply also provides hand creams and lotions for preventing surgeons from infections and allergic reactions after wearing gloves for long time periods during lengthy surgeries. Septoodont Hand Cream Tube, VioNex Skin Lotion, Monarch Revitalizing Hand Lotion Pump Bottle, and Hand Essentials Skin repair Cream are especially formulated for rejuvenating damaged and affected skin after prolonged gloves wearing during lengthy oral surgical treatments. Glove Dispenser and Hold-it Gloves Box Holder are provided to the dental health care professionals for keeping gloves safe and away from liquids and moisture.
